ocr.notes: One significant error: the last quoted sentence reads 'There is another good fight left in me yet', not 'good night'. Headline and 'Special to the Post-Dispatch' not in the transcript.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported from New York that the Allen-Sullivan match was off: neither side's representative appeared at Harry Hill's, and Hill would return Richard K. Fox's $1,000 forfeit posted for Allen, who said he had been sick.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Wednesday, December 6, 1882, page 5.

facts.fact: The proposed Allen-Sullivan match fell through when neither W. E. Harding for Allen nor Bob Farrell for Sullivan appeared at Harry Hill's; Hill said he would return Richard K. Fox's $1,000 forfeit check posted for Allen
Allen said he had been sick and had not left the house since his exhibition, and that he was going to Chicago to see the Sullivan-Elliott glove contest and would fight the winner if he mended
facts.quote: I have not been out of the house since the exhibition. I have been sick. I am going to Chicago to see a glove contest between Sullivan and Elliott, and if I mend a bit I will have a go with the winner. There is another good fight left in me yet.

notes: Fact dates are 'yesterday' and 'last evening' relative to the December 6 dispatch. 'Elliott' is presumably Jimmy Elliott, but the article gives only the surname.
